items: How many pillars of Islam are there?
The five pillars are the declaration of faith, prayer, zakat, fasting and Hajj.
How many articles of faith (pillars of iman) are there?
Belief in God, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and divine decree.
Which statement does a person say to enter Islam?
The Shahadah: there is no god but God and Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
How many obligatory daily prayers are there?
Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha.
How many units (rak'ahs) are in the obligatory Maghrib prayer?
The Maghrib prayer has three rak'ahs.
How many units (rak'ahs) are in the obligatory Fajr prayer?
The Fajr prayer has two rak'ahs.
How many units (rak'ahs) are in the obligatory Dhuhr prayer?
The Dhuhr prayer has four rak'ahs.
How many units (rak'ahs) are in the obligatory Friday prayer?
The Friday prayer is two rak'ahs after the sermon.
What is the act of placing the forehead on the ground in prayer called?
What is the bowing posture in prayer, with hands on the knees, called?
What is the sitting posture in prayer called?
The sitting posture is called qa'dah.
What is the opening takbir that begins the prayer called?
Saying 'Allahu akbar' to enter the prayer is takbirat al-ihram.
Towards what do Muslims face in prayer?
Muslims face the Kaaba (qiblah) in Mecca.
What was the first qiblah of the Muslims?
For about sixteen or seventeen months Muslims prayed toward Jerusalem, then the qiblah changed to the Kaaba.
Which part of the body is wiped (not washed) in wudu?
The face, arms and feet are washed; the head is wiped.
What replaces wudu when no water is available?
Tayammum is done with clean earth.
What is washing the whole body after major impurity called?
Ghusl is the full ritual bath.
What is the call announcing the time of prayer called?
The adhan announces the prayer time.
What is the second call given just before the obligatory congregational prayer begins?
The iqamah signals that the prayer is about to start.
Who gave the first adhan in Islam?
What is delivered before the Friday congregational prayer?
The khutbah is a condition of the Friday prayer.
How many Eid prayers are there each year?
Which movements are not performed in the funeral prayer?
The funeral prayer is performed standing with takbirs, without ruku' or sujud.
In which month is fasting obligatory?
What is the meal before dawn in Ramadan called?
What is the meal that breaks the fast at sunset called?
Iftar is breaking the fast at sunset.
At what time does the fast begin each day?
The fast begins at true dawn.
What is the charity given before the Eid al-Fitr prayer called?
Zakat al-Fitr is paid before the Eid prayer.
In which month does Eid al-Fitr fall?
On which day of Dhul-Hijjah is Eid al-Adha?
How many categories of zakat recipients are listed in the Quran?
Verse 60 of At-Tawbah lists eight categories.
What is the minimum amount of wealth on which zakat becomes due called?
What is charity whose reward continues after death called?
Ongoing charity such as building a mosque or digging a well.
In which month is Hajj performed?
The main rites of Hajj are in Dhul-Hijjah.
Which is the most essential rite of Hajj, performed on the Day of Arafah?
What is circling the Kaaba seven times called?
Tawaf is walking around the Kaaba.
What is walking between Safa and Marwah seven times called?
Sa'i is part of Hajj and Umrah.
What are the special garments and state of intention for Hajj or Umrah called?
Ihram is the sacred state entered with intention and special clothes.
Where are the pillars stoned during Hajj?
The stoning (rami) takes place in Mina.
What is the black stone at the corner of the Kaaba, the starting point of tawaf, called?
The Black Stone marks the start of tawaf.
What is the black cloth covering the Kaaba called?
The Kaaba is covered with a black kiswah.
What is the blessed water in Mecca that gushed for Hajar and Ismail called?
Zamzam is the well near the Kaaba.
Which statement is correct about Umrah?
It can be performed at any time of the year
It is performed only on Arafat day
It is performed only in Ramadan
It is performed only on Eid al-Adha
Hajj has fixed days; Umrah can be done throughout the year.
In which city is the Kaaba?
The Kaaba is in the Sacred Mosque in Mecca.
Which three mosques are the ones for which a journey may be undertaken?
The Sacred Mosque, the Prophet's Mosque and Al-Aqsa
The hadith names these three mosques.
How many of God's most beautiful names (Asma' al-Husna) are well known?
A hadith says God has ninety-nine names.
Which angel is entrusted with delivering revelation?
Jibril is the angel of revelation.
